scope.taxonomySafety: Only products with matching controlled taxonomy evidence receive a canonical tag. Unrelated products are not forced into a target collection.
scope.merchandisingSafety: Union collection membership only after canonical identity is unambiguous and live-readback succeeds.
scope.sourceHandling: Preserve source collections until canonical membership and redirects are verified.
scope.productPublications: Do not mutate product sales-channel publications.
scope.existingTags: Preserve existing tags; only add missing controlled target tags where evidence supports them.
scope.redirects: Create and verify redirects before retiring a public collection URL.
